page.overview:
Who is Ilmarë?

Ilmarë (Quenya) was chief amongst the Maiar and the handmaiden to Queen Varda.

She was the handmaiden of Varda (thereby a guardian spirit of the stars) and one of the chiefs of the Maiar, along with Eönwë, the herald and banner-bearer of King Manwë.

In Quenya, Ilmarë means "Starlight", from ilma. Christopher Tolkien has noted that Ilmarë is related to such words as Ilmen and Ilmarin. It also resembles Ilmarinen, a character from Kalevala, one of Tolkien's influences.

Earlier in the growth of J.R.R. Tolkien's legendarium, Manwë and Varda, both called with the title of Wanwavoisi, were the parents of Ilmarë and Eönwë, that in this version were named Erinti and Fionwë Úrion. Tolkien later abandoned this idea of the Children of the Valar.
